subject.title: [Feature]: Collapsible messages in Control UI chat

question: Should Control UI add inline collapse for long assistant Markdown, and what default threshold/newest-message/global-control policy should it use?
rationale: The missing behavior is a UX product choice rather than a broken existing contract, and current code already has overlapping side-reader, JSON, tool, and duplicate-message disclosure patterns that should stay coherent.

options.title: Approve Bounded Inline Collapse
options.body: Implement a first version that collapses older long assistant messages by line or height threshold, keeps the active or latest response readable, and defers global controls unless maintainers want them now.

options.title: Prefer Existing Side Reader
options.body: Treat the canvas/sidebar reader as the supported long-message escape hatch and decline inline collapse for now.

options.title: Defer To Broader Chat UX
options.body: Keep the request open until maintainers make a broader chat readability and accessibility design decision.

recommendation.title: Approve Bounded Inline Collapse
recommendation.body: Implement a first version that collapses older long assistant messages by line or height threshold, keeps the active or latest response readable, and defers global controls unless maintainers want them now.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest product-routing candidate from the available review and adjacent Control UI history.
